description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell: cracked gravestone, rusty iron cage, dark ritual altar, stone pillar wrapped in chains, pit leaking purple smoke, cluster of black candles with purple flames, small demon gargoyle statue, pile of skulls and bones, broken dark mirror on a stand, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
